problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: volume 59 m³
* Shipment Beta: volume 41 m³
* Shipment Gamma: volume 70 m³
* Shipment Delta: volume 67 m³
* Shipment Epsilon: volume 67 m³
* Shipment Zeta: volume 48 m³
* Shipment Eta: volume 63 m³
* Shipment Theta: volume 64 m³
* Shipment Iota: volume 60 m³
* Shipment Kappa: volume 53 m³
* Shipment Lambda: volume 36 m³
* Shipment Mu: volume 30 m³
* Shipment Nu: volume 51 m³
* Shipment Xi: volume 52 m³
* Shipment Omicron: volume 59 m³
* Shipment Pi: volume 39 m³
* Shipment Rho: volume 64 m³
* Shipment Sigma: volume 47 m³
* Shipment Tau: volume 33 m³
* Shipment Upsilon: volume 34 m³
* Shipment Phi: volume 58 m³
* Shipment Chi: volume 41 m³
* Shipment Psi: volume 61 m³
* Shipment Omega: volume 49 m³
* Shipment A1: volume 70 m³
* Shipment B1: volume 62 m³
* Shipment C1: volume 39 m³
* Shipment D1: volume 40 m³
* Shipment E1: volume 67 m³
* Shipment F1: volume 34 m³
* Shipment G1: volume 45 m³
* Shipment H1: volume 62 m³
* Shipment I1: volume 40 m³
* Shipment J1: volume 59 m³
* Shipment K1: volume 32 m³
* Shipment L1: volume 37 m³
* Shipment M1: volume 63 m³

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 m³ of cargo. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume in a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
